Modern translations listed on SuttaCentral include four translations across three languages, including an English version by John Kelly [SuttaCentral].

No cross-language parallels in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan are recorded on SuttaCentral or identified by DharmaNexus [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, automated text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus identifies internal Pali textual overlap with three works [DharmaNexus]. In addition, segments §3.1–4.4 are aligned by DharmaNexus with verses in the *Kavidappaṇanīti* (§525–529) and the sub-commentarial *Milindaṭīkā* (§885–890) [DharmaNexus].
